cmd: mkdir -p out && for b in Genesis Exodus Leviticus Numbers Deuteronomy Joshua Judges I%20Samuel II%20Samuel I%20Kings II%20Kings Isaiah Jeremiah Ezekiel Hosea Joel Amos Obadiah Jonah Micah Nahum Habakkuk Zephaniah Haggai Zechariah Malachi Psalms Proverbs Job Song%20of%20Songs Ruth Lamentations Ecclesiastes Esther Daniel Ezra Nehemiah I%20Chronicles II%20Chronicles; do n=$(echo "$b" | sed "s/%20/_/g"); ok=0; for t in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -sS -L -A "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; textcheck/1.0)" -o "out/$n.json" "https://www.sefaria.org/api/texts/$b?lang=he&pad=0&commentary=0&context=0&wrapLinks=0" && head -c 1 "out/$n.json" | grep -q "{" && ok=1 && break; sleep 8; done; echo "$n ok=$ok size=$(wc -c < out/$n.json)"; done
